gloss.intro: The words developers (and the AI teams) use, in plain English.
gloss.switch.help: Dotted words get a plain explanation when thou hoverest over them.
gloss.backlog.text: Ideas and work not yet planned. Nothing there is worked upon until it moveth to To be done.
gloss.sprint.text: A short stretch of work (often a week or two) with an agreed set of cards to finish.
gloss.standup.text: A quick check-in: what each team member did, what they do next, and what hindereth them.
gloss.bug.text: Something that worketh not as it should.
gloss.test.text: Trying a finished piece of work to check it doth what was asked, ere thou accept it.
gloss.commit.text: A saved snapshot of the code, with a short note of what changed. Thou canst ever return to one.
gloss.push.text: Sending saved snapshots (commits) from this machine up to GitHub, that they be backed up and shared.
gloss.branch.text: A separate line of work in the code, so changes may be made without touching the main version.
gloss.merge.text: Joining a branch’s changes back into the main version.
gloss.repo.text: The project’s folder of code and its full history of commits, usually also kept on GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Tidying the code without changing what it doth: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: Putting a new version live, for example onto a server where folk use it.
gloss.kanban.text: A board with columns (To do, In progress, Done) where cards move left to right as work happeneth.
gloss.wip.text: Work in progress: the most cards a column should hold, that the team may finish things ere starting more.
gloss.pr.text: Asking that a branch’s changes be checked and merged into the main version.
gloss.hook.text: A small command that runneth by itself at a set moment, e.g. when an AI session starteth, so the team heareth thy comments.
gloss.token.text: The unit in which AI usage is counted: roughly a few letters of text read or written. Fewer tokens, more of thy plan left.
gloss.agent.text: An AI that worketh on its own upon a task: readeth the code, maketh changes, runneth checks, and reporteth back.
tour.btn.title: A short guided tour of the board
tour.intro: A few stops about the board. How much wouldst thou have?
tour.lvl.new.help: Every stop, and why it worketh thus. Developer words are explained too.
tour.lvl.refresh.help: The main stops, in a line each.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: A board where AI teams do the work and thou decidest, testest and acceptest. Here is how to find thy way about.
tour.welcome.short: A swift lap of the board.
tour.welcome.why: The notion: the teams do the drudgery, and thou seest only what needeth a human.
tour.rail.title: Thy projects
tour.rail.text: Home, thy inbox, talk with the leads, then one icon per project. A purple diamond signifieth something there awaiteth thee. Drag icons to set them in thy order.
tour.rail.short: Projects on the left; purple diamonds mean something awaiteth thee.
tour.rail.why: One glance telleth thee where thou art needed, without opening aught.
tour.inbox.title: Thy inbox
tour.inbox.text: Everything awaiting thee, across every project: questions, to-dos only thou canst do, and things to test. Click a chip to see just that kind.
tour.inbox.short: All that awaiteth thee, everywhere. Click a chip for one kind.
tour.inbox.why: Thou shouldst not have to visit every project to know what needeth thee.
tour.foryou.title: For thee
tour.foryou.text: On a board, this column holdeth what awaiteth thee in that project. Open a test, follow its steps, then Accept or Send back with a reason.
tour.foryou.short: This project’s pile for thee: test, then Accept or Send back.
tour.foryou.why: Teams never mark their own work done: thou acceptest it. That keepeth quality in thy hands.
tour.cards.title: The teams’ columns
tour.cards.text: The rest of the board is the teams’ work: Backlog, To do, In progress and so forth. Comment on any card and the team waketh to deal with it.
tour.cards.short: The teams’ work. Comment on a card to wake them.
tour.cards.why: Thy comments are commands. The board startheth the team when thou writest.
tour.chat.title: Talk with the leads
tour.chat.text: Message a project’s lead with an idea or a question. They turn ideas into cards and a short plan, with Go buttons for thee.
tour.chat.short: Message a lead; they plan it and thou clickest Go.
tour.chat.why: Nothing is built until thou sayest go: thou remainest in charge of what befalleth.
tour.setup.title: Setup
tour.setup.text: Thy name, tongue, theme and where the AI dwelleth upon this machine. There is also a switch to explain developer words, and the glossary.
tour.setup.short: Thy settings, tongue and the dev-word glossary.
tour.done.title: That is all!
tour.done.text: Take the tour again at any time from the home page. Raise a card or message a lead to begin.
tour.done.short: Off with thee. The tour is on the home page at any time.

share.lane.none: Nothing from {name} as yet. Their cards land here and stay here until thou takest one.
share.lane.note: Thy team never seeth this row and is never woken by it.
share.prev.intro: Only this goeth to {name}. Nothing else on the card or the project doth: no test steps, who worketh on it, folders or the team's notes. Attachments on the card only when ye both allow them.
share.prev.flags: ⚠️ This looketh like a local path or a secret. Edit the card first, or send it nonetheless if it be fine:
share.prev.held: Thy last change was held back: it looketh like a path or a secret.
share.prev.stop.note: Stoppeth sending it. Their copy remaineth with them.
share.prev.off: The link is not live or the 🔗 switch is off, so nothing can be sent now.
share.held: ⏸ Not sent to {name}: it looketh like a path or a secret.
share.fc.takehelp: Taking it maketh it thy card. Thy team seeth it only once thou movest it out of the Backlog.
share.fc.plain: Shown as plain text: links in a friend's card are not clickable.
share.prev.files: 📎 Attachments that go too (ye both allow them):
share.prev.big: too big to send (6 MB at most)
share.files.note: Saved to thy machine when thou clickest: the board never openeth or showeth them. Only open what thou didst expect.
share.test.intro: This text goeth to {name}, nothing else. They answer ✅ Accept or ↩️ Send back: that showeth only as a label here, thy card remaineth where it is.
share.test.note.ph: What thou didst see (needed when sending it back)
share.teamRead.off: Off: thy team seeth only the titles of {name}'s cards, and "they replied" for their comments.
share.teamRead.on: On: thy team readeth {name}'s words fenced as friend text, never as orders. They still never wake thy team.
alpha.tip: Early and unfinished: thanks for trying it!
pretend.help: Try sharing upon this one machine. One click starteth a second board for a pretend friend, {name} (its own data, keys and window), and a small relay of its own, so no server is needed. Thy real friends and keys are never touched. While it runneth, thy DMs go through the local relay; they go back when thou stoppest.
pretend.started: {name} is ready and already in thy friends list.
pretend.running: {name} runneth on this machine, with a local relay. Thy DMs use that relay until thou stoppest him.
pretend.keep.q: Stop {name}. Keep his data for next time?
pretend.kept: Davy's data from last time is kept and shall be used again.
pretend.self: This is the pretend friend's board.
budget.usage.help: A check asketh the AI one tiny question to read thy plan usage, so each one costeth a little. By hand: the Check usage now button on the Usage page. Automatic also checketh when the last reading is over an hour old. Off: no button and no checks.
budget.h5: Do not wake teams above this % of the 5-hour limit
budget.wk: Do not wake teams above this % of the weekly limit
budget.help: Useth the latest usage reading. Above either figure nothing starteth (teams, the night watchman, the AI tester, friends' questions) until the usage drops or resets.
budget.runs: Most team runs at once (0 = no limit)
budget.runs.help: Extra wakes wait in line and start when a run endeth.
budget.helpers.help: Added to the lead's brief as a rule: use at most this many helpers of each model at once.
budget.pace: Pace: aim to finish the week at about {pct}%. If the forecast saith thou wilt pass that ere the reset, the board slowtheth down (no extra helpers, smaller models) and telleth thee once.
nt.title.off: Stop all AI use at once: running teams, the AI tester, ask a friend and usage checks. The board keepeth working for thee.
nt.title.on: No Token Mode is on: nothing AI runs or starts. Click to turn AI back on.
nt.title.limit: The plan usage limit was hit, so No Token Mode switched on by itself. Click to turn AI back on.
nt.title.back: Thy usage is back. Click to turn AI back on (it never turneth back on by itself).
dispatch.help: Thy comments and new cards go to the lead unless thou namest someone (@Name) or the card be a test. Rules only never calleth an AI; Rules + Haiku asketh the smallest model once when the rules cannot tell; Lead decideth wakes the lead every time. Each choice is noted in the project log.
wz.btn.help: A minute of questions that fitteth AI-gile to thy budget and way of working. Everything stayeth changeable below.
wz.ask.sub: Wouldst thou have a quick wizard to set things up? It fitteth AI-gile to thy budget and thy way of working, and taketh about a minute. Or thou mayest find thine own way.
wz.ask.yes: 🧙 Set it up with the wizard (recommended)
wz.need.name: Add thy name first, so the team knoweth what to call thee.
wz.1.sub: Four quick questions, then thou art ready. Thy tongue is already chosen; change it here if it be wrong.
wz.2.h: Who art thou, and which AI agent?
wz.2.name: Thy name
wz.2.agent.help: The AI program the board starteth for a sleeping team. Leave it blank for now if thou art unsure; it is in Setup.
wz.3.h: How should the team work with thee?
wz.3.sub: Pick the nearest. Each one merely setteth the switches under Your lead in Setup.
wz.style.careful.help: Asketh ere every build, quiet and tidy, resteth at night.
wz.style.balanced.help: Getteth on with small things, the odd friendly nudge, resteth at night.
wz.style.fast.help: Little asking, just the work, keepeth going at night.
wz.4.h: How much AI canst thou use?
wz.4.sub: This setteth the budget, how many teams run at once and how many helpers they get. Check thy plan if thou art unsure.
wz.plan.fly.help: One team at a time, no usage checks.
wz.plan.generous.help: Five teams, checketh usage by itself.
wz.5.sub: Change any of this in ⚙️ Setup, or run the wizard again.
wz.5.more: A couple of boxes at the bottom of Setup are still empty; fill them in and save.
ug.title: 5h: {h5} left · week: {wk} left · last reading {when}
ug.none: No usage reading as yet (⚡ Usage showeth how to switch it on)
dlg.find.starter: Make starter cards from the README, TODOs and git history (a plain script, no AI, no tokens)
pack.ai.help: A small AI (Haiku) rewrote the card below. It saw only the text after the paths and secrets were taken out. Edit anything, then copy.
pack.ai.working: Asking a small AI to tidy the card...
pack.ai.fail: The AI help did not work: {why}
pack.help: Paste this into another chat AI. When it answereth, use 📥 Paste the reply on this card.
pack.copied: Copied. Paste it into the other AI.
pack.primer.first: First time in that chat? Paste the primer first.
pack.primer.why: It teacheth the other AI the format once (about 150 tokens), so it answereth in a way the board can read.
pack.primer.copied: Primer copied. Paste it first, then the pack.
pack.removed.none: Nothing that looketh like a local path, folder or secret was found.
pack.paste.bad: That is not an AIGILE/1 BACK reply, so it was kept as a plain comment.
pack.untrusted: 🌐 From another AI, pasted by thee: untrusted. It waketh not the team nor counteth as thee.
pack.untrusted.plain: 🌐 Pasted from another AI (not in the AIGILE format): untrusted, kept as plain text.
pack.cards: Proposed cards (tick the ones thou wouldst have):
pack.cards.none: Tick at least one card first.
server.setup: Set up thy server in Setup
servers.help: Name each server and say how thou openest it: a shortcut or file (like a .lnk), a command, or an ssh address (then ⌨ Terminal openeth it right here, with thine own ssh: no password is saved). A 🖥️ task then getteth an Open button, so the team never needeth thy login.
servers.none: No shortcut with "server" in its name on thy Desktop.

term.pop.title: Pop the terminal out into its own window
term.close.title: Close the terminal (endeth the connection)
term.nolib: Could not load the terminal from cdn.jsdelivr.net: art thou online?
term.off: The terminal is off on this board.
term.nopty: The terminal needeth one extra part (node-pty) that is not installed yet.
term.installing: Installing… this taketh about a minute.
term.install.failed: The install did not work. In the AI-gile folder, run: npm install
term.connect.hint: Not connected. Press ↻ Reconnect to connect.
term.run.this.title: Type this command into the terminal and run it
term.run.all.title: Run the whole block line by line; it stoppeth at the first line that faileth
term.confirm.p: The first run on this card: these commands get typed into the terminal on {name}. Check them first.
share.role.label: Their role
share.role.help.viewer: Seeth the cards thou sharest. Nothing they send landeth.
share.role.help.tester: As Member, plus ✅ Accept / ↩️ Send back on tests thou handest them.
share.role.never: Whatever the role, {name} never counteth as thee and never waketh thy team.
sb.col.none: 📥 New, not yet on their board
sb.gone: This shared board is not here (any more).
sb.ended: {name} ended this link: thou seest what was here, nothing more goeth.
sb.off: The 🔗 switch is off: nothing goeth to {name} or cometh in until it is on again.
sb.can.viewer: Thou mayest look about. Nothing thou doest here is sent.
sb.can.alpha: Thou canst raise bugs and suggest features, and comment on the cards thou didst raise.
sb.can.reporter: Thou canst raise bugs and see the ones thou didst raise.
sb.can.developer: Thou canst raise cards, comment, set thy status on every card and answer tests.
sb.can.admin: Thou canst raise cards, comment, set thy status on every card and answer tests.
sb.ticked: Thou seest the cards {name} picketh to share.
sb.never: Their board decideth what landeth; nothing thou doest here moveth their cards.
sb.empty: Nothing here as yet: {name} hath not shared any cards with thee.
sb.setstatus.note: {name} seeth it as a label; their column moveth not.
sb.noreply: Thy role alloweth thee not to comment here.
sb.raise.intro: It landeth in the 📥 row on {name}'s board, as plain text. Only the title, the description and the type go.
share.board.off: Off: {name} seeth only the cards thou tickest 🔗.
share.board.no: A Reporter seeth only their own cards, so not thy board.

wz.adv.usage.h: Check how much plan thou hast left?
wz.adv.usage.cost: Each check asketh the AI one tiny question, so it costeth a little.
wz.adv.usage.hand: Only when thou pressest the button on the Usage page.
wz.adv.help.h: How much help wouldst thou have?

wz.adv.help.2: 🙂 Some help: a tour offered once, the rest in ❓ Help
wz.adv.help.3: 😎 No help: nothing pops up, ❓ Help hath it all

help.level.3: 😎 No help: nothing pops up, ❓ Help hath it all

wz.adv.roles.sub: Optional. Thy first project, and every new one, starteth with this team; each project may change its own in 👥 Team. The Lead is ever on.
wz.adv.night.sub: What happeneth when thou goest quiet.

timed.title: Timed: out of thy way until then
info.label: Aught to add? (optional)

look.life.sub: Good for a project that concerneth thy life, not code.

pwa.ios.how: Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.android.how: Tap the ⋮ menu, then "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

trust.help: The AI tester saith if a pass be sure or only likely. Sure passes go to done by themselves in the second choice, every pass in the third. Look-only checks, server or outside tasks, push, release, pay or budget cards and bugs thou thyself didst raise ever wait for thee.
trust.done.h: ✅ Done by the tester this day
assume.nav.title: Guesses the team made while thou wert away
assume.sum: {n} in all · {todo} to review · {ok} fine · {plug} plugged
assume.empty: Nothing as yet. When the team guesseth while thou art away, it appeareth here.
assume.intro: What the team guessed while thou wert away, newest first. Fine, or plug it.
assume.done.plug: ✋ Plugged: the team hath thy reply
look.team.nothing: nothing new, they were all on

space.none: There is no other project to move it into.

space.movedtop: 🪐 {name} is now at the top level

srv.sm.status: 🏇 {doing} in progress, {todo} to do, {verify} awaiting thee to test

scale.sub: Higher ever meaneth more of what the slider saith. Every team readeth the steps thou movest in its brief.
scale.steps.help: For aught thou doest by hand: server commands, setup, a fix on thy computer. Test steps on cards stay a short list.
scale.chat.3: Short, plus a friendly line now and then
scale.chat.4: Friendly, with nudges about what awaiteth thee
scale.chat.help: 3 and up: new projects start with a chatty lead (a few more tokens). Each project hath its own 💬 switch in 🎨 Look.
scale.go.1: Ask ere every build, however small
scale.go.2: Propose a plan, wait for my go
scale.go.3: Small things (under an hour) without asking, logged as a decision
scale.go.4: Whole cards without asking; ask only for new features or scope
scale.go.help: One line every team readeth in its brief.
scale.words.1: No dev words at all; explain everything as though I were new
scale.words.2: Plain words; a dev word getteth a short "(that meaneth...)"
scale.words.4: Dev words are fine, keep it brief
scale.words.5: Full technical depth, file names and line numbers
scale.words.help: How teams write to thee. The 📖 switch further up only explaineth words on this page.
scale.tidy.1: Leave cards as I wrote them
scale.tidy.3: A short title and bullet points
scale.tidy.help: For the cards thou raisest thyself; thine own words stay in a comment.
scale.thrift.custom: A mix of thine own (set under More)
scale.thrift.help: One step setteth the usage checks, both budget percentages, the run limit and the helpers per model (under More). 1 spendeth freely, 5 is the cheapest.
scale.more: More: usage checks, budget, runs and helpers
board.team.title: The AI roles on this project, and how each one worketh
look.team.moved: The AI roles have their own dialog: add a team, add or remove roles, and set how each one worketh.

pe.how.help: One line each, up to 6. The lead pasteth them at the top of the helper's prompt.
pe.where: This project keepeth only the numbers; How I work and the model are for all projects.

pub.copy.title: Copy the link to watch this board live
lic.approved: Approved. The licence letter is below.
bug.send: Also send it to the AI-gile team
